# F-<n>: <short title>

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Found** | date, lab, tool or method |
| **Location** | URL / file:line / resource |
| **Category** | CWE-xxx, OWASP Top 10 category |
| **CIA impact** | C / I / A |
| **Likelihood × impact** | … → **Risk: Low / Medium / High / Critical** |
| **Principle** | link |
| **Status** | Open / Fixed / Accepted (owner, expiry) |

## Description
What's wrong, in two or three sentences a developer would understand.

## Evidence
The command and the real output that show it. Redact secrets.

## Recommendation
The fix, at the right layer, and any second layer (defence in depth).

## Verification
The command and output that show the fix works, and the CI gate or test that stops it coming back.
